cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before I pay the builder, will you sign that my fence can stay on our boundary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Could you put 'can stay' beside your name? The builder won't invoice 'suppose.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Date it today, then. If you change your mind, we'll know which permission changed.
